differences.a_observable: Tighter camera framing on the central cards.
differences.b_observable: Wider camera framing showing more of the surrounding grid.
differences.fix: Adjust camera position and focal length for a tighter crop.

differences.a_observable: Shallow depth of field with blurry background tiles and Recurly card.
differences.b_observable: Deep depth of field with sharp background tiles and Recurly card.
differences.fix: Enable camera depth of field and adjust aperture to blur background.

differences.a_observable: Prominent, soft shadows cast by the cards onto the background.
differences.b_observable: Faint, washed-out shadows, making the scene look flat.
differences.fix: Increase shadow density and adjust light source settings for softer shadows.

differences.a_observable: Warm, saturated golden-yellow color on the Recurly card.
differences.b_observable: Cooler, desaturated yellow color on the Recurly card.
differences.fix: Adjust the yellow material color to be warmer and more saturated.

json.highest_impact_fix: Adjust the camera's position, focal length, and depth of field settings to match the tighter framing and shallow focus of the reference video.
